entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: The query is 214 aa long with estimated molecular weight 22.76 kDa, theoretical pI 4.83, and predicted net charge −10.28 at pH 7.
Pfam identifies a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 9–209 with i-Evalue 8.2e−60.
Strongest homologs are reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases, including Geobacillus kaustophilus Q5KWI6 at 50.5% identity and 93.5% query coverage.
Homolog annotations support Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of dITP, ITP, and XTP to the corresponding monophosphates plus diphosphate; exact substrate preference remains an inference from homology.
Reference homologs are annotated as cytosolic homodimers with EC 3.6.1.66.

entities.name: Ham1p-like pyrophosphatase
observations: Ham1p-like proteins are small nucleotide-pool sanitizing enzymes associated with dITP/XTP/ITP diphosphatase activity.
The query sequence matches the Ham1p_like Pfam family with very strong statistical support.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: Candidate reaction: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+, mapped to Rhea RHEA:28342 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: Candidate reaction: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+, mapped to Rhea RHEA:28610 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: Candidate reaction: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+, mapped to Rhea RHEA:29399 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit for dITP/XTP/ITP pyrophosphatase activity.
